raw_answer_text:
A1: The router consults the Unicast RIB (the "Unicast RIB lookup" step shown in the flow).
A2: The source address (the lookup is performed for the packet coming "from 198.51.100.7").
A3: NOT STATED.
A4: It compares that interface against the interface on which the packet actually arrived (Ingress ge-0/0/1).
A5: The router looks up the route back toward the source first, then compares it to the arrival interface (rx → lookup → verdict).
A6: It passes when the packet arrived on the "upstream" interface (yes branch), and the router accepts and forwards it.
A7: It fails when the packet did not arrive on the upstream interface (no branch), and the router drops it as an RPF failure.
A8: NOT STATED.
